open_points.subject: NodeExecution writing ownership
open_points.text: "Every record type has one writing module." and later "The record that concludes an operation element ... is built and written by `effects` ... Every other record ... is built and written by `runs`."
open_points.question: Which module is the single owner of NodeExecution writes, and how is that ownership enforced for all statuses?
options: `effects` writes operation-node NodeExecutions and `runs` writes all others (split ownership by subtype)
`runs` is the only writer of NodeExecution; `effects` returns facts and `runs` persists them
`store` exposes specialized write calls and is treated as the effective owner of NodeExecution persistence
open_points.default_guess: Split ownership by subtype (`effects` for operation conclusions, `runs` otherwise).

open_points.subject: ManifestOperation shape vs send-time needs
open_points.text: M10 candidate fields include `base_url` but not instance `required_headers` or instance `class`; A08 rule 2 requires reading "`api_base_url` and `required_headers`" and A09 rule 4 depends on instance `class`; State 3 says `check_binding_current` returns M10 with "`api_base_url`, `required_headers` and class of the instance".
open_points.question: Are `required_headers` and instance `class` part of ManifestOperation data, a separate instance object, or fetched independently at send time?
options: Extend M10 (or its runtime DTO) to include `required_headers` and instance `class`
Keep M10 as-is and return a second structure with instance transport facts
Have `service_invoker` re-read instance facts directly from `installation` during prepare/send
open_points.default_guess: Return a composite from `bindings.check_binding_current` that includes operation fields plus instance transport facts.

open_points.subject: Run outputs persistence
open_points.text: M19 candidate field: "`outputs`: StoredValues by flow output port, as produced;" versus State 3: "The run's answer ... is computed by `runs` from the trace when asked and is not stored".
open_points.question: Is run output state persisted in Run records, or always derived from trace/element records at read time?
options: Persist `Run.outputs` and also derive response reasons from trace
Do not persist outputs; derive both values and reasons from trace every read
Persist only produced value references, but compute reasons and final presentation on read
open_points.default_guess: Do not persist outputs as authoritative; derive run answer from trace on read.
